svg.aria-label: Animated examples for 18 of OmniRoute's 19 combo routing strategies. The cache-optimized strategy is documented in the adjacent routing table.
svg.desc: Animated grid of 18 routing-strategy tiles; static tracks show each flow on the first frame while a small dot repeatedly travels the path each illustrated strategy takes.
